# x402 JSON Schema Validator

> Lightweight, deterministic JSON Schema validation + optional coercion for agent pipelines. No external deps beyond core. Pay-per-call via x402 (USDC on Base).

## Endpoints

- GET /catalog – free discovery
- GET /api/validate – service info
- POST /api/validate – paid validation

## Pricing

~0.004 – 0.012 USDC per call (default max 0.008 USDC)

## Input

```json
{
  "data": { ... },
  "schema": { "type": "object", "properties": {...}, "required": [...] },
  "options": { "coerce": false, "removeAdditional": false }
}
```

## Output

```json
{
  "success": true,
  "valid": true,
  "errors": [],
  "coerced": { ... }   // only if coerce=true and valid
}
```

Perfect for agents that need to enforce contracts before downstream calls or storage.
